name: mcp-abap-adt
description: MCP server for ABAP ADT in SAP ECC/S/4HANA (on-premise) and SAP BTP ABAP Cloud: repository analysis and CRUD for RAP and classic ABAP. Twelve packages, one binary each: the full, compact and read-only tool sets over stdio (destinations and logins; SAP over HTTP, RFC or SNC), Streamable HTTP or HTTP+SSE (credentials from x-sap-* headers)
